name: TrueMeme
description: Shows the Morgan Freeman meme next to True/False when a boolean variable is defined in Python.

pythonBoolIcons.trueIcon.description: Absolute path to the image shown next to True.

pythonBoolIcons.falseIcon.description: Absolute path to the image shown next to False.

pythonBoolIcons.iconSize.description: CSS size of the icon (e.g. 1em, 14px), to be fixed lol.
